independence_declaration.statement:
I (domain-reviewer) wrote no implementation in the reviewed scope.
- transformation-analyst wrote the analysis, register, coverage files, glossary, field inventory, journeys, permissions matrix, acceptance map and stage plan.
- delivery-orchestrator wrote the agent definitions, runner, write guard, gate tooling, extraction scripts and delivery records.

I formed this verdict without reading any other round-15 review record. I wrote only review evidence under docs/delivery/test-evidence/DG0/domain/round-15/, plus this record and its verification sidecar. I executed code only in disposable clones under my private $TMPDIR.

checks_run.procedure:
Confirm the frozen candidate:
1. Record the main-repository HEAD.
2. Clone the repository into $TMPDIR, check out the candidate commit and recompute the candidate ID.
3. List every path changed after the freeze that is not delivery metadata.
checks_run.command: git rev-parse HEAD; git clone -q /home/user/My-owns $TMPDIR/review-dom15 && git checkout -q 7fab49c5 && node tools/gates/candidate.mjs --stage DG0; git diff --name-only 7fab49c5..HEAD | grep -v -E '^docs/delivery/(assignments|candidates|stages.json|test-evidence|runs)'
checks_run.environment: Claude Code Bash sandbox (bubblewrap, no network), node, disposable clone $TMPDIR/review-dom15
checks_run.expected: The candidate ID recomputes to sha256:b7f60ed3…abddb5e. Any post-freeze commits touch only the delivery metadata that D-005 excludes.
checks_run.actual: The main-repository HEAD is 2c24f2e. The two commits after the freeze (c17b84e: round-15 freeze and assignments; 2c24f2e: live guard probe evidence) touch only D-005 metadata, and the grep prints nothing. candidate.mjs prints sha256:b7f60ed34dd77f93ca454edb545da1cee8e9cd7cdb649b5ad3895c454abddb5e in both the working tree and the clone at 7fab49c5. review-common.md explicitly allows this metadata-only case. Every check below ran against the clone at 7fab49c5.

checks_run.procedure: Independent extraction fidelity check. Unzip the docx into $TMPDIR and walk word/document.xml and footer*.xml with my own regex tokenizer (w:t, w:tab, w:br), without python-docx or the project's extraction scripts. Normalise the text, then check that every paragraph appears in playbook.md in order and that every table cell and footer paragraph is present.
checks_run.expected: The docx SHA-256 is 2584a352…548ad2. No paragraph is missing or out of order, and no table cell or footer paragraph is missing.
checks_run.actual: sha256 2584a35282804e639a697478eae75a55a43cfb8c551345dfc7636b9b34548ad2. paragraphs=1001 missing=0 out_of_order=0; tables=49 rows=239 cells=885 cells_missing=0; footer_paras=1 footer_missing=0. prefreeze also re-ran the project's own sandboxed extraction reproducibility check, which reported PASS (DOM15-08).

checks_run.expected: 165/165 blocks covered with no duplicates or dangling IDs, every REQUIREMENT block cited, and every non-requirement rationale true.
checks_run.actual:
165 coverage rows: 129 REQUIREMENT, 29 CONTEXT, 7 NON-REQUIREMENT. Nothing is missing, extra or duplicated, and there are 0 dangling IDs and 0 'does not cite' lines. All 93 SOURCE rows cite B blocks, and all 129 REQUIREMENT blocks are cited by the register.

Manual reading: the 29 CONTEXT rows are headings or labels (PHASE n, TEMPLATE, section titles), each pointing to the requirement that covers the substance. The 7 NON-REQUIREMENT rows are the cover title, strapline, cover figures, version stamp, the reference-list heading, the reference URLs and the 'How to extend' Excel/PowerPoint advice. All rationales are true. No dropped substance was found (see also DOM15-03 and DOM15-04).

checks_run.procedure: Re-verify F-DG0-012 from scratch, as the round-15 assignment requires after the round-14 incident. In disposable clones of the old runner (6c61f2e) and the round-15 candidate (7fab49c5), extract entry(), config_snapshot() and each commit's own comparator verbatim from run-agent.sh. Snapshot before and after 11 cases (A–K), with HOME redirected into $TMPDIR. Also inspect the D-028 runner diff for interference with the config scan.
checks_run.command: bash docs/delivery/test-evidence/DG0/domain/round-15/06-f012-verification.sh; git diff 1e64eb02..7fab49c5 -- tools/agents/run-agent.sh; grep -n trap tools/agents/run-agent.sh
checks_run.expected: Old runner: D, E, G and I report nothing (the defect). New runner: D, E, G and I report '<path> removed'; B, C, F and H are still reported; A and J report nothing; K fails closed. The D-028 change does not affect the scan.

- Finance validates, owner accountable: REQ-PB-013 (a Business Owner gets 403 on validate), REQ-S08-003 (accountable business owner plus Finance validator) and REQ-S07-014 (pending, not validated).
- RAG from trajectory: REQ-S07-007 and REQ-PB-063 ('100% tasks complete but KPI below trajectory is Red/Amber'; missing data shows Unknown).

- The two 'SUSPECT CLAIM' lines are honest disclaimers ('inspired by'; 'Nothing here is an official PMI standard').
- REQ-PB-042, 058 and 069 separate source (B0063/B0088/B0105) from master-prompt additions (M0147/M0173/M0216) in prose, and check_pb_provenance passes.
- T11 SLAs sit in REQ-PB-065/066 and the field inventory (DOM15-03), not in permission cells. The matrix maps T11 and T12 roles and labels the mapping as an implementation assumption.
- Health-check three-action enforcement is labelled an interpretation.

132 glossary rows with Arabic read as sensible business Arabic, including the earlier F-DG0-005 corrections. The journeys cover Diagnose→G1 … Realize→G6, modular entry, KPI update, Finance validation, the committee workflow, BAU handover and admin publishing (all OK).
